input.summary:
P4 porch in the angle is furnished inside its box x49..52, y3..5, z9..11: two stair chairs, a spruce fence and top-slab table with a standing lantern, and a barrel with flower pot beside a water cauldron wash stand in the corner.
The lane stays clear from the steps down x51 to the wing door, and the cell in front of the gable door (52,3,10) is kept free. make.sh wrote a whole build.nbt with 8 placed, 0 refused, 0 off-palette; FIT is OK and the light at the feet is 11 or more with no dark cell.
Walkability and the hanging lantern depend on the porch deck, steps and beam from other parts, which are still stubs in this copy, so the room check reports no way in.
left: Walk verdict is UNREACHABLE only because the porch deck (y2), the steps x51..52 z8 and the wing/gable walls are still stubs in this copy; re-run `mcd room` after the shell/fittings parts merge and confirm the lane x51 z9..11 and the cell (52,3,10) reach every furniture cell.
The floating groups from `mcd check` (stairs, lantern, pot, slab, cauldron at y3..5) sit on the missing deck at y2 and should clear when the porch floor is built.

The brief asked for a hanging lantern; none is placed because it needs a block above it at y6 from the porch beam, which fittings owns. The one lantern is standing on the table top at (50,5,10). Add a hanging lantern under the beam at (51,5,10) if the beam lands there.
The brief asked for a bench; it is two spruce stair chairs (50,3,9) and (49,3,10) facing the table, not a single bench piece.
plan.md and elements.md have no checkbox row for this room's furniture, so nothing was ticked.

waste.what: Worked out the 4x3 interior floor layout cell by cell (which cells are lane, post, door cell, furniture) by hand from the plan grid.
waste.cost: about 3 tool calls and one rewrite of the layers rows
waste.tool: A `mcd plan` option that marks the lane and door-front cells as reserved, and returns the free cells as a ready layers() legend.

waste.what: Import error: layers() was imported from vocab.mjs, which does not export it (it lives in the build library), so the first make.sh failed.
waste.cost: one failed make.sh run and one edit
waste.tool: vocab.mjs should re-export the build-library helpers (layers, bed, flight, chimney) so a part can import everything from one place.

waste.what: Checked the room verdict by hand: UNREACHABLE and the floating groups come from the missing deck and steps, not from my cells, so I had to reason about which problems were mine.
waste.cost: two mcd room/check runs plus reading the floor grid
waste.tool: `mcd room --only` could take a flag that treats cells owned by unbuilt stub parts as expected gaps instead of failing the walk.

companions.task: Place the hanging lantern under the porch beam (51,5,10) and check the lantern-spot suggestions once the deck and beam exist, so the corners stay at light 8 or more.
Build the porch deck at y2 and the steps x51..52 z8 so the room's walk and floating checks can be run against a real floor, and fix the rail gap that the posts at (49,9) and (52,9) cross.
